key.name: video-path
key.summary: Absolute path of the video to play
key.description: Empty means no wallpaper. Set with: neowallpaperlive set FILE

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Whether the live wallpaper is playing
key.description: neowallpaperlive exit sets this to false without forgetting video-path.

key.name: fill-mode
key.summary: How the video is fitted to each monitor
key.description: cover: scale to fill, crop the excess (default). contain: scale to fit, letterbox shows the static wallpaper. stretch: ignore aspect ratio.

key.name: keep-awake
key.summary: Keep the computer awake while the wallpaper is playing
key.description: While a video is playing, inhibit automatic suspend and idle screen blanking/locking (gnome-session flags 4|8). Has no effect while the wallpaper is stopped. Set with: neowallpaperlive awake on|off

key.name: pause-when-covered
key.summary: Pause when every monitor is covered by windows
key.description: Stop decoding while each monitor's work area is hidden behind a maximized, fullscreen or equally large window on the current workspace. Resumes as soon as any part of the wallpaper becomes visible.

key.name: pause-on-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause while a fullscreen window is on top of any monitor
key.description: Games and video players get the GPU to themselves, even if other monitors still show the wallpaper.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Uses UPower's OnBattery. The last frame stays on screen.

key.name: glass
key.description: Blur what is behind the top bar and the Ubuntu Dock (the wallpaper and any window passing behind) and tint them translucent. Set with: neowallpaperlive glass on|off

key.name: glass-radius
key.summary: Blur radius of the glass, in logical pixels

key.name: glass-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the tint over the blur
key.description: 0 shows the blurred backdrop only, 1 is a solid bar. Applies to the top bar and, through the dock's own settings, to the dock.

key.name: glass-full-redraw
key.summary: Repaint the whole screen on every change while glass is on
key.description: Blur reads pixels that were already painted; with Mutter's usual partial repaints it reads its own old output and a dark square flickers around hovered icons. Turning clipped redraws off while glass is on prevents that, at some GPU cost. Set with: neowallpaperlive glass redraw full|clipped

key.name: glass-dock-backup
key.summary: The dock's own transparency settings, saved while glass is on
key.description: Internal. Restored when glass is turned off, so the dock goes back to exactly how it was.

key.name: mpv-extra-args
key.summary: Extra command-line arguments appended to the mpv renderer
